scope: Read-only narrow corrected watchdog and retained fake-control receipt review. No tests, process scans, signals, runtime, tool relocation or Go-tree hashing executed by this reviewer.
findings: Post-spawn checkpoint failure enters the outer exception handler and settles the known owned child before attempting another receipt save.
Timeout checkpoint save is enclosed in a finally that invokes settlement, so receipt persistence failure cannot skip the bounded TERM/KILL waits.
Settlement does not write checkpoints; a failed failure-receipt save falls back to a static failure projection and does not undo settlement.
Live-leader PID/startTicks checks precede each group signal; an exited leader does not trigger a group signal. Group/descendant settlement remains explicitly unobserved.
Timed, forced, exception or unknown settlement cannot produce a successful wrapper result.
limits: 420 seconds bounds the declared process waits only: Python/OS scheduling and synchronous filesystem/stdout/stderr operations are not preemptively bounded.
Leader exit is not a descendant census; explicit groupSettlementUnobserved must not be restated as zero owned descendants.
This review does not authorize or certify the actual restoration, current free space, live source/manifest parity or process quiescence. Those are operation-time checks.
